from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess
r=Path.cwd();t=r/'.local/step07-ci-sixphase-duration';ws=json.loads((t/'final/workspace.json').read_text());w=r/ws['workspace'];source=ws['source'];assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=w);mp=next((w/'artifacts').glob('step07-*/manifest.json'));m=json.loads(mp.read_text());assert m['commit']==source;rows=[]
for n,h in m['files'].items():
 b=(mp.parent/n).read_bytes();assert b==(w/n).read_bytes()and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==h;rows.append({'path':n,'sha256':h,'bytes':len(b)})
assert len(rows)==206;parentdir=r/'artifacts/.step07-required-body-final-83766ea69ddb4594953515ca22b8f6b1/artifacts/step07-1be820a5adfb-b0249713e2495dce';p=json.loads((parentdir/'manifest.json').read_text());changed=[n for n,h in m['files'].items()if p['files'][n]!=h]
for n,h in p['files'].items():assert hashlib.sha256((parentdir/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h
newmeta=json.loads((mp.parent/'apps/api/dist/resources/studio.json').read_text());oldmeta=json.loads((parentdir/'apps/api/dist/resources/studio.json').read_text());assert newmeta['context']['commit']==source;newmeta['context']['commit']=oldmeta['context']['commit'];assert newmeta==oldmeta
profilehash=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(m['profile'],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest();assert profilehash=='48844001eea07a8cf0da4baf9abb1653b01c38a9405413ed3123df189cf48793'
for mode in ['production','dev']:
 o=json.loads((w/'.local/e2e'/(mode+'.json')).read_text());assert o['stats']['expected']==18 and o['stats']['unexpected']==0 and o['stats']['skipped']==0
out={'source':source,'buildId':m['buildId'],'manifestPath':str(mp.relative_to(r)),'manifestSHA256':hashlib.sha256(mp.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'manifestBytes':mp.stat().st_size,'payloads':len(rows),'actualAllLiveImmutableSHARecomputed':True,'parentSource':'1be820a5adfbb3c41c532fbc778958774ed1c470','actualChangedPayloads':changed,'actualUnchangedPayloadCount':len(rows)-len(changed),'profileSHA256':profilehash,'originalParentArtifactUnmodified':True,'files':rows};(t/'engineering-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:out[k]for k in ['source','buildId','manifestSHA256','actualChangedPayloads','actualUnchangedPayloadCount']}))
